description.text: Twenty-four cards, 001/T to 024/T, given only with Pokémon Card Trainers magazine: three in each issue from volume 14 in January 2002 to volume 21 in March 2003, when the magazine stopped. Instead of the black star PROMO symbol they carry a book with a card on it. Each issue's three cards belong together: Flareon, Vaporeon and Jolteon; the Slowpoke family; the middle stages of the Johto first partners, then of the Kanto ones; the three legendary birds; the Dratini line; the Larvitar line up to Tyranitar ex; and Imakuni?'s Whismur, Loudred and Exploud ex. Their release overlapped with the P and ADV-P promos.

description.text: Given with Pokémon Card Trainers Vol. 21, the issue of March 2003 and the magazine's last, together with Imakuni?'s Loudred 023/T and Imakuni?'s Exploud ex 024/T. Trainers was the magazine of the Pokémon Card Fan Club, sent only to its members. It was relaunched with Vol. 14 in January 2002, now six issues a year, and each issue from then to the last, Vol. 21 in March 2003, came with three cards numbered as T promos, 001/T to 024/T. Unlike the first 18 T promos, the last six are dated 2003 and printed in a newer frame, without the e-Reader strip. Imakuni?, a Japanese musician, appears on many of the game's joke cards, and these three are his Pokémon. Whismur's Poké-Body forbids both players to open their mouths more than 1 cm while speaking for as long as it is in play: "Absolutely!"
